papers.line: Do you think we'll make the papers?
stanza: Born into money, it's not a crime
You can fool the people all the time
Nine hundred dead in Jonestown
Rescued from a shopping mall
Heiress with a little girl's soul
Do you think we'll make the papers?

papers.line: I am opening drawers, I am sifting through papers
stanza: When will I ever be safe from myself
If the danger all lies between heaven and hell?
When I close my eyes, I'm not falling asleep
I am opening drawers, I am sifting through papers

papers.line: With her name on all his papers
stanza: He has seen her at the office
With her name on all his papers
Through the sharing of the profits
He will find it hard to shake her from his memory
And she's so busy being free

papers.songTitle: In the Heat of the Summer
papers.line: "For shame, for shame," wrote the papers
stanza: "For shame, for shame," wrote the papers
"Why the hurry to your hunger?
Now the rubble's resting on your broken streets
So see what your rage has unraveled"
I can think of nowhere
I would rather be
Reading morning papers
Drinking morning tea

papers.line: It was all over the papers
stanza: The announced it over the wireless
New Years Eve at midnight
It was all over the papers
That Britain was now tongue-tied
Maybe they did it out of kindness
Maybe they did it out of politeness
TV stopped giving away prizes
There was radio silence
Trade union meetings
School assembly choirs
On every football terrace
Even the WI

vapors.line: Club filled Gold with greedy vapors
stanza: Club filled Gold with greedy vapors
Till his long, green eyes did glow
And Mudd was left with the sighs and trembles
Watching his hard earned money go
